solutions.LA07-RETAINED-REPAIR-1: Opened doing action of gate opening; whispered and shouted saying, with quieter versus louder delivery. Same quoted words; no proven reason/feeling from shouting alone.
solutions.LA07-RETAINED-REPAIR-2: Remembered thinking/memory of ending; liked and loved feeling about story. Loved usually expresses stronger positive feeling than liked in this comparison; either actual intended effect can be explained with context.
solutions.LA07-RETAINED-REPAIR-3: Is relates playground to exciting description; opened presents an event at Monday time; has relates possession/features two slides. Brilliant/exciting describe or evaluate, not the whole verbs in those clauses.
solutions.LA07-RETAINED-REPAIR-4: Is in is quiet relates gardener to quiet description. Is digging is whole doing verb group; is helps digging. Same word is functions differently with context.
